Press Release
City of Victorville Launches New Pet Licensing Program to Help Residents
Keep Pets Safe

*         Simplified online licensing and 24/7 lost pet protection now
available           for City of Victorville dog owners*

*FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: July 1, 2026*

*VICTORVILLE, Calif.* — On July 1, the City of Victorville launched a new
pet licensing and lost-pet-recovery platform to offer residents an easier,
convenient, and user-friendly method to license their pets.  Implementation
of the DocuPet platform is part of the City’s ongoing commitment to
leveraging technology to improve customer service, operational efficiency,
and public safety.

The new registration platform offers a secure online portal that is
available 24 hours a day, seven days a week; and pets licensed through the
system will have added protections offered by DocuPet’s HomeSafe® 24/7 Lost
Pet Recovery Service.

“Licensing is an important responsibility for dog owners, but it should
also provide peace of mind,” said Victorville Mayor Liz Becerra.  “By
partnering with DocuPet, we’re making the licensing process simple while
ensuring local families have extra protection if their pet ever goes
missing.”

Every licensed pet will receive a complimentary DocuPet identification tag
containing a unique identification code linked to a secure online pet
profile.  If a pet becomes lost, owners can immediately create a Lost Pet
Report through the system, triggering notification and recovery tools
designed to reunite pets with their families.  Community members who find a
lost pet can use the tag information to quickly contact the owner or
DocuPet’s 24-hour recovery team.

The system also provides automated license renewal reminders to prevent
expired licenses and free pet identification tags with every license.

While the online platform emphasizes online convenience, residents who need
assistance will continue to receive in-person support from City Staff at
City Hall or the Animal Care and Adoption Center.

For safety, all dogs in the City of Victorville must be licensed and
vaccinated against rabies.   Cat licensing is voluntary but highly
recommended to ensure their safety.

Pet owners can learn more and register online at Victorville.docupet.com.
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fvictorville.docupet.com%2Fen_US%2F%3Futm_medium=email%26utm_source=govdelivery/1/0100019f1fe3ebeb-c9c8a20c-7041-4482-b377-46b6ad56c4a2-000000/V3bY-1iXg-o4DM7CFioyo-cXo4jac2jnW84lXNJ1sws=452>

Located in Southern California at the high-point between Los Angeles and
Las Vegas, Victorville is the leading city for both industry and retail in
the High Desert Region.  Victorville is a growing, vibrant community that
is home to nearly 142,000 residents and some of the area’s largest
employers, including the City-operated Southern California Logistics
Airport.  Clean air, abundant mountain vistas, family-friendly recreation
activities, spectacular sunsets, and breathtaking night skies entice locals
and visitors alike to fall in love with this city that is within a few
hours of SoCal beaches, National Parks, mountain retreats, and other major
attractions.  Ontario International Airport is less than an hour away.
Learn more about the City of Victorville at VictorvilleCA.gov
